title: The host stays when he carries the story
text: The host stays when he carries the story (HKS-8 confirmed, rule 3 rewritten): the chapter question, the challenge the viewer wants asked, the clearest summary, the verdict, legal cover. Cut his warm-up, clarifying questions, name checks, filler and most jokes.

source.heading: Confirmed by the user (2026-11-24, answers to the overnight study's questions)

confirm: For each kept host line, which carrying role does it play?
